front.title: HTTP6 W1 Binding for Autonomous AI Agents

abstract.t: An autonomous artificial intelligence agent can delegate work, call an external tool, and retry an operation after the person who authorized it has gone offline. This document specifies W1, an HTTPS binding that lets the tool provider verify which agent is acting, the authority it inherited, and the resource effect requested. Signed approval and delegation records carry the human's limits. A time- bounded execution permit reserves a shared allowance. The provider links its response to the request and supplies a receipt for the charge it committed. A companion corpus supplies public test keys, exact signed messages, initial states, and expected observations for eleven cases. Independent implementers can exchange these artifacts and compare what occurred at the resource.
